title: Vice President of Compliance and Quality – Home Health and Hospice
description:
Vice President of Compliance and Quality – Home Health and Hospice
 
If you are a Chief Compliance Officer, Compliance Officer, Executive Vice President of Quality, or Senior QAPI leader with Home Health and Hospice experience then you need to read on….
 
Vice President of Compliance and Quality Opportunity Description
 
Our client is a well-established and growing Home Health and Hospice Care organization.  They are looking for a Vice President of Compliance and Quality. This person can be remotely based in the Southeast. Some travel is expected. A tech savvy and multi-site compliance leader with 10 years of home health and / or hospice compliance experience is required.
 
Vice President of Compliance and Quality Requirements
  • Multi-site home health and / or hospice experience.
  • 10 years of compliance experience in home health or hospice.
  • Expert in Medicare regulations, Hospice COP’s, and HIPPA.
  • Bachelor's degree in Nursing, Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Public Health, Legal Studies, or a related field required.
 

Vice President of Compliance and Quality Responsibilities
  • Assess, develop, and lead organizational Compliance program.
  • Standardize and improve policies and procedures across multiple offices.
  • Travel as needed to individual locations.
  • Mentor and develop regional compliance teams.
  • Analyze EMR and other data points to look for areas of improvement.
 
The compensation scale listed is a general salary range and is not intended to represent the actual annual or hourly compensation rate for this role. An offer will be made to the selected candidate at the conclusion of the interview process based on their relevant experience and the responsibilities of the position. Our client does offer a competitive compensation package potentially including incentives, health and dental insurance, PTO, retirement plans (401K) and opportunities for professional development.
